text:
sasha: main CI went red ~20m ago, lots of e2e flakes but consistent failure in runtime/cache_integ_test::KvCacheStress and a few eviction assertions. job: https://ci/red/12345. Last green was commit abc1234 (~5h ago). Suspect merge of PR #4329 that touched the cache eviction layer landed ~2h before the red. Can someone help bisect?

mike: I can run a bisect on the infra-bisect runner. can you paste the exact reproduce command / failing log snippet?

sasha: repro command: ```./ci/run_integration --filter KvCacheStress --runs 20 --seed 42```
failing log excerpt: `kv_cache.cc:245] eviction: expected 1024 keys but found 768 (shard 3)`

infra-bot: CI job 12345 failed: runtime/cache_integ_test::KvCacheStress — logs available at https://ci/red/12345/logs (automated failure notice)

olga: i pulled the job logs locally and can reproduce one failure with your command. stack trace points to cache/evict.cc:line 78 where we compare counts after a concurrent trim. looks timing-sensitive.

jess: can we get the bisect range? last-good = abc1234 per sasha, what's first-bad? i think the merge commit for #4329 is def5678 (merge commit).

mike: starting git bisect on bisect-worker-7. steps: build+test per commit, will run the reproduced command with --runs 5 to speed up. posting updates.

mike: quick status: bisect narrowed to a commit authored by @tim (def5678) that altered eviction heuristics and introduced a new async trim path. repro rate jumps after that commit.

sasha: thanks — looks like a likely culprit. Can we revert/rollback the merge to unblock CI while folks look for a fix? hold merges to main if possible.

olga: opened revert PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4401 (revert def5678). Marked as revert and added reviewers: @tim, @jess, @sasha. also added `deploy-blocker` label.

tim: thanks for the ping — i'm looking into it now. if revert is preferred for safety i'm fine; i can also push a follow-up patch that adds stricter invariants and more tests.

jess: given CI/regressions, prefer revert then follow-up patch. I'll approve revert PR and request fast-track. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: label `deploy-blocker` applied to PR #4401 by jess.

mike: bisect results + revert applied to main in staging; kicked a staging run and e2es are green so far. will promote revert to main once staging stays green for 10m.

sasha: excellent. please post when main CI is green and remove hold. also note to rotation: @oncall please watch the next hour for any regressions.

mike: main CI back to green after revert and merge revert PR. monitoring for 30m. closing bisect run.

olga: follow-up: added a failing unit test to a provisional branch capturing the concurrency window so we don't regress again. will open a PR after the revert is fully rolled out.

sasha: perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
